FAQ

Frequently Asked Questions

Everything you need to know before you book — honest, clear and customer-friendly.

What towels are used?

We use premium microfiber towels only, so your paint stays protected while we safely lift dirt and dry surfaces.

Do we need to provide water for exterior work?

If you have water, that's great. If not, we bring our own and can use a waterless wash while still protecting your paint.

Do we need to provide electricity?

Yes — we need access to a standard electrical outlet so our equipment can run smoothly and the detail is completed safely.

Do we pay before or after?

You only pay once the service is finished and you're satisfied. If anything bothers you, we'll redo it until it's right.

Do you use harsh chemicals?

No harsh chemicals. We use safe, effective products that are gentle on paint, trim and glass while still delivering a deep clean.

What is Excalibur Special Exterior?

Excalibur Special Exterior is our premium exterior service: a full exterior wash followed by a light polish and a temporary ceramic sealant. The process gives an enhanced wet-look shine, extra surface slickness, and short-term protection between full ceramic coatings.

Includes: exterior wash → paint-friendly polish → temporary ceramic sealant for improved gloss.

How much time does the service take?

Depending upon the service selected, it usually takes 2–3 hours. Basic interior details are on the faster end, while ceramic coating and premium services may take the full duration. We'll give you an exact timeline when you book.
